messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — we're proposing a small breaking change for the API response envelope and a clarifying change to model pinning semantics. Planning a staggered rollout and need reviewers + a brief canary window.

marta: TL;DR: rename `model_info.version` -> `model_version` (flat field), and remove the `envelope.v1` wrapper for streaming+nonstream. Clients should be able to opt into the old behavior via `X-Compat-Envelope: v1` for 3 weeks.

marta: Why: the nested envelope complicates our SDKs and causes double-wrapping for some proxying setups. The flat `model_version` simplifies telemetry and pinning checks.

anya: ok — timeline?

marta: proposing: docs + SDK shims go out Mon, canary rollout to 5% traffic Tue, widen to 50% Wed if no regressions, full flip after 7 days. Compat header accepted for 21 days.

josh: quick Q: does this affect streaming tokens shape? some customers parse chunks assuming `envelope.data.delta`

marta: good point. Streaming chunks will keep the same delta payload, just moved up one level. example: old stream chunk -> `{"envelope": {"data": {"delta": ...}}}` new -> `{"data": {"delta": ...}, "model_version": "redwood-1"}`. We'll keep the `delta` payload identical.

sam: will there be an SDK shim that rewrites the old shape to new so we don't force immediate client changes?

marta: yes — SDKs will auto-detect `envelope` and unwrap for a 3-week grace period. We'll also add a runtime flag `REDWOOD_KEEP_ENVELOPE=true` for Hosted customers that want to postpone.

ryan-pm: what's the comms plan? docs + migration guide + a short post in #announcements?

marta: exactly. Docs + migration guide with code snippets, changelog entry, and an announcement post. I'll draft a short template for customers impacted by pinned model behavior.

marta: about pinning: we're also clarifying server behavior when `X-Model-Pin` header is absent. Previously unpinned requests implicitly used a default model that could flip during upgrades. New policy: if no pin header, we return `model_version` as the currently-served default and commit to not change the default more than once per 30 days without explicit deprecation notice.

josh: nice. That reduces silent surprises. How do we surface the current default to clients?

marta: response includes `model_version` and `model_family`. Example (curl):

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"input":"hi"}' \
     https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# -> {"data": {...}, "model_version":"redwood/rl-2026-03", "model_family":"redwood/rl"}
```

anya: will we add an Accept-style header for negotiation? `Accept-Model: redwood/rl;version=2026-03` ?

marta: we considered that, but to keep client-side simple we'll prefer `X-Model-Pin` for explicit pinning and `Accept-Model` for future negotiation. For this rollout we only support `X-Model-Pin`. `Accept-Model` is on the roadmap.

sam: any infra caveats for Dedicated / Private customers?

marta: Dedicated: we'll expose the same flags and the compat header. Private: customers can opt-out of the auto-unwrapping via config. Ops note: make sure the canary routing keeps payload inspectors that assert `model_version` present once unwrapped.

deploy-bot: deploy job #3421 started for service: api-gateway (canary cluster -> 5%).

josh: reviewers: @anya and @sam can you skim the SDK shim PR when it's ready? I'll add you as reviewers.

anya: sure — prefer we add unit tests that cover both wrapped and unwrapped stream chunks.

sam: will run perf tests — streaming throughput must stay within 5% of baseline.

marta: action list:
- Docs: marta (draft + migration guide)
- SDK shims: josh (js/py shims, auto-detect)
- Canaries + infra flags: sam (routing + REDWOOD_KEEP_ENVELOPE)
- Comms: ryan-pm (announcement + customer emails for high-usage accounts)

marta: anyone opposed to the 21-day compat header window?

josh: fine by me. can we put a feature flag to extend for specific enterprise accounts if needed?

marta: yes — enterprise exceptions via account-level flag. we'll log exceptions for audit.

ryan-pm: I'll prepare a short customer-facing FAQ and a list of top 10 customers to ping directly.

marta: thanks all. I'll open the draft PRs and the docs today. ping here when the PRs are up and I'll coordinate the canary start. :party_parrot:

josh: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/780 (WIP) :eyes:

anya: added initial tests in that branch — looks good so far.

sam: perf runs queued. I'll post numbers before the canary widens.

marta: excellent — closing loop here but will update thread as we progress.
